steps.remove_module: Car Wash Site Screener — Austin, gates-first

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open. It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue. Sites come from brokers by email, but for now I'll type the address. Today I check households within 3 miles (at least 45,000) and the traffic on the road (at least 30,000 cars a day), then I score the site and write a short memo. Start with Austin, Texas. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply:
I've written up the plan as "Your workflow" — it's on the card now. Quick gist:

Give an address → Alpha geocodes it, checks the nearest TxDOT traffic count against your 30,000/day bar, estimates households within 3 miles from Census block-group data against your 45,000 bar, then scores it and writes a short memo with every number and its source. Each screen lands as a row in a table, starting with Austin.

Two open calls, each with my pick as default: how the score should combine the two gates, and which traffic count to use at a corner lot. I also flagged (as suggestions, not built) that you

steps.say: Start fresh and ignore anything built before. Keep it to what I said. Write the page now, with your picks on anything you don't know.
steps.reply:
The fresh page is on the card now — no leftover zoning/competitor/parcel scope from before, just the two bars you named.

Gist: you give an address → Alpha geocodes it, checks the nearest TxDOT traffic count against 30,000 cars/day, estimates households in a straight 3-mile radius from Census data against 45,000, scores it, and writes a short memo. My picks where you didn't say: straight-line radius (not drive time), and a score that's the average of how far over each bar the site is. Say the word and I'll build it.
